text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm done shopping, it's time to
go
train—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my glasses! I can't run with them
slipping off
so easily like this. I'd better
get them adjusted.

text_block_list.name: Optometrist
text_block_list.text:
How do they feel now? I tightened them
to be
more suitable for running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I came to a shop that specializes
in
sportswear. You were so fast, I should
be able to
make it back in time for...
Wait.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but they're a bit tight. Could you
loosen
the hinges a little, please?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ack... Now they feel strange against my
nose! I
think the height of the nose pads
needs to be—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's already time for training... But
I can't
focus like this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In fact, my training efficiency will surely
drop if I
try to ignore the problem.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that will negatively affect my actual
race
performance!

text_block_list.name: Optometrist
text_block_list.text:
Um... So would you like me to make
another
adjustment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ensuring my glasses are properly
fitted and
then making up the lost
training time afterwards
is the most
efficient course of action!

Biwa Hayahide ends up skipping
training...
